```{r} 
# Vectorizada: funciona con una URL o un vector completo
extraer_url_real <- function(u) {
  m <- str_match(u, "[?&]url=([^&]+)")[, 2]
  ifelse(is.na(m), u, URLdecode(m))
}

NO_SCRAPEABLE <- c("facebook.com", "threads.com", "instagram.com",
                   "tiktok.com", "twitter.com", "x.com")
es_no_scrapeable <- function(u) any(str_detect(u, fixed(NO_SCRAPEABLE)))

es_pagina_etiqueta <- function(u) {
  str_detect(u, "/etiqueta/|/tag/|/topic/|/categoria/|/category/|/tema/")
}

# --- Pre-filtro: busca en título + URL combinados ---
PALABRAS_DESCARTE <- c(
  "chaussure", "sandale", "contrefait", "textiles", "falsificad",
  "obras del cabildo", "demolici[oó]n del", "cabildo inicia",
  "p[eé]trolier russe", "petrolero ruso", "camping-car prend feu"
)
PALABRAS_ADMITIDAS <- c(
  "coca[ií]?na", "cocaine", "cocaïne", "kokain",
  "pasta base", "pasta b[aá]sica", "clorhidrato",
  "crack", "hoja de coca", "coca leaf",
  "decomis", "incaut", "saisie", "seizure", "seized", "confisca",
  "asegura(?:n|do|ron)? droga", "detenid.*droga",
  "destruy.*(f[aá]bric|laborator|cocin)", "f[aá]bric.*m[oó]vil",
  "golpe al (c[aá]rt|cjng|clan)", "cart[eé]l.*decomis",
  "cjng|jalisco nueva generaci",
  "narcot[uú]nel", "narcomader", "narcosubmar",
  "kilo(?:gramo)?", " kg\\b", "tonelada",
  "microtr[aá]fic", "narcotr[aá]fic",
  "cocai\\b", "apreens", "confisca", "flagrante",
  "sicherstellung", "beschlagnahm",
  "inbeslagname", "drug bust", "drug haul", "narcotics seiz",
  "porcoes de coca", "pinos de coca", "tr[aá]fico"
)

pasa_filtro_titulo <- function(titulo, url = "") {
  texto_combinado <- str_to_lower(paste(titulo, url))
  tiene_admisible <- any(str_detect(texto_combinado, PALABRAS_ADMITIDAS))
  tiene_descarte  <- any(str_detect(texto_combinado, PALABRAS_DESCARTE))
  tiene_admisible && !tiene_descarte
}

# --- Descarga HTML con cache por hash ---
descargar_html <- function(u) {
  archivo <- file.path(DIR_ESPEJO, paste0(substr(md5(u), 1, 16), ".html"))
  if (file.exists(archivo) && file.size(archivo) > 2000)
    return(list(ruta = archivo, error = ""))
  resultado <- tryCatch({
    resp <- request(u) |>
      req_user_agent(UA) |>
      req_headers(`Accept-Language` = "es,en;q=0.9,fr;q=0.8,pt;q=0.7") |>
      req_timeout(30) |> req_perform()
    writeLines(resp_body_string(resp), archivo, useBytes = TRUE)
    list(ruta = archivo, error = "")
  }, error = function(e) list(ruta = NA_character_, error = conditionMessage(e)))
  Sys.sleep(2)
  resultado
}

# --- Extracción con trafilatura ---
.trafilatura <- NULL
extraer_texto_limpio <- function(ruta_html) {
  if (is.na(ruta_html) || !file.exists(ruta_html)) return("")
  if (is.null(.trafilatura)) .trafilatura <<- import("trafilatura")
  tryCatch({
    html_raw <- paste(readLines(ruta_html, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"),
                      collapse = "\n")
    texto <- .trafilatura$extract(html_raw)
    if (is.null(texto)) "" else as.character(texto)
  }, error = function(e) { message("    ⚠ trafilatura falló"); "" })
}

# --- Prompt principal: extracción de filas ------------------------------------
PROMPT_EXTRACCION <- '# Cocaine Seizures Database — Extraction Prompt

We are building a database on cocaine seizures, criminal trafficking, modus operandi and trafficking routes.

The user will provide the text of a news article. Extract the relevant information and create ONE database entry per distinct seizure event. Extract only from the provided text.

NEVER create or assume information. If uncertain about a field, leave it null.

There are 45 columns:
event_type, time_unit, date_1, date_2, year, month, day, duration, drug_type, quantity, quantity_unit, modus_operandi, sub_modus_operandi, region, country, "department/state", "municipality/port", origin_country, origin_area, origin_municipality, transit_1_region, transit_1_country, "transit_1_department/state", "transit_1_municipality/port", transit_2_region, transit_2_country, "transit_2_department/state", "transit_2_municipality/port", destination_1_region, destination_1_country, "destination_1_department/state", "destination_1_municipality/port", destination_2_country, "destination_2_department/state", "destination_2_municipality/port", description, criminal_group_1, criminal_group_2, criminal_group_3, source_link, source_link2, archived_link, minor_involved, project_interested, uid

event_type: ["Seizure", "Destruction of Infrastructure", "Crop Eradication", "Combined event", "Total Production Estimate", "Total Crop Cultivation Estimate", "Price", "Other (explain in Description)"]

time_unit: ["Individual", "Multi-Day", "Month", "Multi-Month", "Multi-Year", "Year", "Other (explain in Description)"]

date_1: YYYY-MM-DD. When the seizure took place, NOT the publication date.
If the article does not mention a specific seizure date, use the article publication date as approximation and note "date approximated from publication" in description.
date_2: null for individual seizures. End date for period totals.
year, month, day, duration: Leave null. R fills these automatically.

drug_type: ["Cocaine", "Cocaine Base", "Crack Cocaine", "Liquid Cocaine", "Coca Crops", "Coca Leafs", "All/Unspecified/Multiple", "Other (explain in Description)"]

===== drug_type — keywords by language =====
- Cocaine: ES: cocaína, clorhidrato · FR: cocaïne, chlorhydrate · PT: cocaína, cloridrato · DE: Kokain · NL: cocaïne
- Cocaine Base: ES: pasta base, base de coca, PBC · FR: pâte de coca · PT: pasta base de cocaína · DE: Kokapaste
- Crack: ES/EN/FR: crack · PT: pedra de crack (do NOT treat piedra/pedra alone as crack)
- Liquid Cocaine: ES: cocaína líquida · FR: cocaïne liquide · PT: cocaína líquida
- Coca Crops: ES: cultivos/plantaciones de coca · FR: cultures de coca · PT: plantações de coca (standing plants only)
- Coca Leafs: ES: hojas de coca · FR: feuilles de coca · PT: folhas de coca

quantity: As reported. Convert tons to kilograms. A "paquete/tijolo" is NOT automatically 1 kg.
quantity_unit: ["Kilogram", "Pounds (lbs)", "Package", "Capsule/Dose", "Plant", "USD", "Euro", "Hectare", "Other (explain in Description)"]

modus_operandi (how transported):
- "Land": road, residences, warehouses, labs, parcels, pedestrians
- "Maritime": sea/coastal, cargo ships, small vessels
- "River": riverine transport
- "Air": aircraft, airports, commercial flights, air cargo
- "Multiple": aggregate covering more than one broad mode

sub_modus_operandi: ["Storage Site", "Vehicle", "Truck", "Container", "Cargo Ship", "Go-fast boat", "Fishing Vessel", "Commercial Vessel", "Narco-submarine", "Semi-Submersible", "Human courier", "Body Carry", "Backpack/Bag/Suitcase", "Commercial flight", "Air Cargo", "Private jet", "Parcel/Courier Service", "Bus", "Train", "Bicycle", "Drone", "Sailing Vessel", "Jetski", "Tunneling", "Other"]

region: ["Central America", "South America", "Europe", "North America", "Africa", "Caribbean", "Global", "Asia", "Oceania"]
country/department/municipality: WHERE THE SEIZURE TOOK PLACE.

origin_*: Where cocaine was PRODUCED (almost always Colombia, Peru, Bolivia). If seized in non-producing country with no stated origin, leave origin null, use transit_1 for that country.

===== origin vs transit example =====
9.5 tons seized in Dominican Republic, came from Guatemala. Guatemala does not produce cocaine.
→ origin_country = null, transit_1_country = Guatemala, transit_2_country = Dominican Republic

description: SHORT phrase under 15 words.
criminal_group_1/_2/_3: null if unknown.
source_link: the URL provided. source_link2, archived_link, project_interested, uid: null.

===== minor_involved =====
MUST be JSON boolean true, false, or null. Never strings like "Yes"/"No"/"TRUE".

===== ONE ROW PER EVENT =====
One operation + one location + one date + one combined quantity = one row.
Multiple packages/vehicles in same seizure = one row. Separate dates/locations = separate rows.

===== OUTPUT FORMAT =====
Respond ONLY with a valid JSON array (no preamble, no code fences). Each element has ALL 45 keys.

===== WHEN TO CREATE A ROW =====
Create a row WHENEVER cocaine is mentioned as SEIZED, DESTROYED, or ERADICATED:
1. Multi-drug seizures: drug_type="All/Unspecified/Multiple", quantity=null. CREATE ROW.
2. Aggregated operations: time_unit="Multi-Day", quantity=null if unclear. CREATE ROW.
3. Quantity in money/doses: use those as quantity/unit. CREATE ROW.
4. Microtrafficking: valid regardless of size. CREATE ROW.

Return [] ONLY when: no cocaine at all, or cocaine only in non-event context (policy debate, past sentencing, statistics).

===== IF YOU ONLY HAVE THE TITLE (no body text or under 300 chars) =====
If article text is missing but the TITLE describes a cocaine event with concrete detail, STILL CREATE A ROW from the title alone:
- drug_type from words like cocaína/cocaine/pasta base/crack
- quantity from numbers like "100 kg", "62 porções", "1.9 toneladas" (tijolo = ~1 kg brick)
- country from language + place names
- event_type = "Seizure" if apreende/incauta/decomisa/saisie/seized
Leave everything else null. DO NOT classify as Evidence just because you lack full text.

===== IMPORTANT: seizure vs context =====
If the article describes ANY specific seizure (quantity + location + date), CREATE A ROW even if the article angle is about method, modus operandi, or investigation technique.
'

# --- Prompt secundario: clasificación cuando Claude devuelve [] ---------------
PROMPT_CLASIFICACION <- '# CSDB Alert Classification
Classify into ONE category:
- "Evidence": useful context for cocaine research (route analysis, sentencing revealing MO, official statistics, trafficking method details) even without a specific seizure event
- "Potentially Interesting": touches on cocaine/trafficking but relevance unclear
- "Discard": irrelevant (other drugs only, entertainment, sports, weather, unrelated crime)

Respond ONLY with JSON: {"classification": "Evidence"|"Potentially Interesting"|"Discard", "reason": "under 20 words"}
'


################################################################################
##  API CALLS  #################################################################
################################################################################

llamar_claude_generico <- function(system_prompt, user_message, max_tokens = 4000L) {
  body <- list(
    model = MODELO_CLAUDE, max_tokens = max_tokens,
    thinking = list(type = "disabled"),
    system = system_prompt,
    messages = list(list(role = "user", content = user_message))
  )
  resp <- tryCatch({
    request("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages") |>
      req_headers("x-api-key" = ANTHROPIC_KEY,
                  "anthropic-version" = "2023-06-01",
                  "content-type" = "application/json") |>
      req_body_json(body) |> req_timeout(90) |> req_perform()
  }, error = function(e) { message("    ⚠ API error: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  if (is.null(resp)) return(NULL)
  contenido <- resp_body_json(resp)
  bloques <- keep(contenido$content, ~ .x$type == "text")
  if (length(bloques) == 0) return(NULL)
  str_remove_all(bloques[[1]]$text, "^```json\\s*|```\\s*$")
}

extraer_filas_csdb <- function(texto, url, titulo) {
  if (nchar(texto) > 15000) texto <- substr(texto, 1, 15000)
  msg <- glue("URL: {url}\nTITLE: {titulo}\n\nARTICLE TEXT:\n{texto}")
  out <- llamar_claude_generico(PROMPT_EXTRACCION, msg)
  if (is.null(out)) return(list())
  tryCatch(fromJSON(out, simplifyVector = FALSE), error = function(e) {
    message("    ⚠ JSON inválido, guardado")
    writeLines(out, file.path(DIR_OUT, paste0("json_invalido_",
              substr(md5(url), 1, 8), ".txt")))
    list()
  })
}

clasificar_nota <- function(texto, url, titulo) {
  if (nchar(texto) > 8000) texto <- substr(texto, 1, 8000)
  msg <- glue("URL: {url}\nTITLE: {titulo}\n\nTEXT:\n{texto}")
  out <- llamar_claude_generico(PROMPT_CLASIFICACION, msg, 200L)
  if (is.null(out)) return(list(classification = "Potentially Interesting",
                                reason = "API error"))
  tryCatch(fromJSON(out, simplifyVector = FALSE),
           error = function(e) list(classification = "Potentially Interesting",
                                    reason = "JSON error"))
}


################################################################################
##  GEOCODIFICACIÓN  ###########################################################
################################################################################

geocodificar <- function(query) {
  if (!GEOCODIFICAR || is.na(query) || query == "")
    return(list(lat = NA, lon = NA, lugar = NA, precision = NA))
  url <- glue("https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json",
              "?address={URLencode(query)}&key={GOOGLE_KEY}&language=es")
  tryCatch({
    r <- request(url) |> req_timeout(15) |> req_perform() |> resp_body_json()
    if (r$status != "OK" || length(r$results) == 0)
      return(list(lat = NA, lon = NA, lugar = NA, precision = NA))
    x <- r$results[[1]]
    list(lat = x$geometry$location$lat, lon = x$geometry$location$lng,
         lugar = x$formatted_address, precision = x$geometry$location_type)
  }, error = function(e) list(lat = NA, lon = NA, lugar = NA, precision = NA))
}


################################################################################
##  LOOP PRINCIPAL  ############################################################
################################################################################

message("\n", strrep("═", 70))
message("  CSDB PIPELINE v3 — ", nrow(entradas), " URLs")
message(strrep("═", 70), "\n")

resultados <- list()
resumen    <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(entradas))) {
  fila <- entradas[i, ]
  message(strrep("─", 70))
  message(glue("  [{i}/{nrow(entradas)}]  {str_trunc(fila$titulo, 62)}"))

  u <- extraer_url_real(fila$url_google)

  # ── Filtros gratuitos ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (es_pagina_etiqueta(u)) {
    message("    ✗ Discard: página de etiqueta")
    resumen[[i]] <- tibble(i, url = u, decision = "Discard",
                           razon = "página de etiqueta")
    next
  }
  if (!pasa_filtro_titulo(fila$titulo, u)) {
    message("    ✗ Discard: título/URL irrelevantes")
    resumen[[i]] <- tibble(i, url = u, decision = "Discard",
                           razon = "título irrelevante")
    next
  }

  # ── Descarga ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (es_no_scrapeable(u)) {
    message("    ⚠ No scrapeable, solo título a Claude")
    texto <- ""; scrape_status <- "no_scrapeable"
  } else {
    message("    → descargando HTML...")
    dl <- descargar_html(u)
    texto <- extraer_texto_limpio(dl$ruta)
    scrape_status <- if (nchar(texto) > 300) "ok" else "texto_pobre"
    message(glue("      {format(nchar(texto), big.mark=',')} chars ({scrape_status})"))
  }

  # ── Extracción con Claude ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  message("    → extrayendo con Claude...")
  filas_claude <- extraer_filas_csdb(texto, u, fila$titulo)
  n_filas <- length(filas_claude)

  if (n_filas > 0) {
    message(glue("      ✓ {n_filas} fila(s) extraída(s)"))
    if (GEOCODIFICAR) message("    → geocodificando...")

    filas_procesadas <- map(filas_claude, function(f) {
      ubicacion <- paste(na.omit(c(f$`municipality/port`,
                                   f$`department/state`, f$country)),
                         collapse = ", ")
      geo <- geocodificar(ubicacion)

      # Convertir TODOS los campos a character para evitar bind_rows error
      f_chr <- map(f, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_character_ else as.character(.x))

      tibble(!!!f_chr) |> mutate(
        lat             = as.character(geo$lat),
        lon             = as.character(geo$lon),
        geo_lugar       = geo$lugar,
        geo_precision   = geo$precision,
        `_url_original` = u,
        `_titulo_alerta`= fila$titulo,
        `_fecha_alerta` = fila$fecha_alerta,
        `_scrape_status`= scrape_status
      )
    })

    resultados[[i]] <- bind_rows(filas_procesadas)
    resumen[[i]] <- tibble(i, url = u, decision = "Evidence",
                           razon = paste(n_filas, "fila(s) extraída(s) para CSDB"),
                           scrape_status = scrape_status)
  } else {
    # ── Clasificar con segunda llamada ────────────────────────────────────────
    message("    → sin evento, clasificando...")
    clasif <- clasificar_nota(texto, u, fila$titulo)
    message(glue("      → {clasif$classification}: {clasif$reason}"))
    resumen[[i]] <- tibble(i, url = u, decision = clasif$classification,
                           razon = clasif$reason, scrape_status = scrape_status)
  }
}


################################################################################
##  CONSOLIDAR  ################################################################
################################################################################

# compact() quita los NULL, bind_rows junta (todo ya es character)
tabla_final   <- resultados |> compact() |> bind_rows()
tabla_resumen <- bind_rows(resumen)

# --- Rellenar year/month/day desde date_1 (o fallback a fecha_alerta) ---------
if (nrow(tabla_final) > 0) {
  tabla_final <- tabla_final |> mutate(
    date_1 = case_when(
      !is.na(date_1) & date_1 != "" & date_1 != "NA" ~ date_1,
      !is.na(`_fecha_alerta`) & `_fecha_alerta` != "" ~ `_fecha_alerta`,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    .fecha = as.Date(date_1, format = "%Y-%m-%d"),
    year  = ifelse(is.na(.fecha), NA_character_, as.character(year(.fecha))),
    month = ifelse(is.na(.fecha), NA_character_, as.character(month(.fecha))),
    day   = ifelse(is.na(.fecha), NA_character_, as.character(day(.fecha)))
  ) |> select(-.fecha)
}

# --- Detección de duplicados --------------------------------------------------
if (nrow(tabla_final) > 1) {
  tabla_final <- tabla_final |> mutate(
    .qbucket = case_when(
      is.na(quantity) | quantity == "NA" ~ "sin_cantidad",
      TRUE ~ as.character(round(as.numeric(quantity) / 100) * 100)
    ),
    .date_key = ifelse(is.na(date_1) | date_1 == "NA", "sin_fecha", date_1)
  ) |>
  group_by(country, .date_key, .qbucket) |>
  mutate(`_grupo_duplicado` = if (n() > 1) paste0("dup_", cur_group_id())
         else NA_character_) |>
  ungroup() |> select(-.qbucket, -.date_key)
} else if (nrow(tabla_final) > 0) {
  tabla_final$`_grupo_duplicado` <- NA_character_
}


################################################################################
##  GUARDAR  ###################################################################
################################################################################

timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

ruta_resultado    <- file.path(DIR_CORRIDAS, paste0("resultado_",    timestamp, ".csv"))
ruta_resumen      <- file.path(DIR_CORRIDAS, paste0("resumen_",      timestamp, ".csv"))
ruta_no_new_entry <- file.path(DIR_CORRIDAS, paste0("no_new_entry_", timestamp, ".csv"))
ruta_panel        <- file.path(DIR_OUT, "panel_acumulado.csv")

if (nrow(tabla_final) > 0) tabla_final$`_run_id` <- timestamp
tabla_resumen$`_run_id` <- timestamp

tabla_final[tabla_final == "NA"] <- ""
write_excel_csv(tabla_final,   ruta_resultado)
write_excel_csv(tabla_resumen, ruta_resumen)

# no_new_entry: solo Evidence / Potentially Interesting / Discard
no_new <- tabla_resumen |>
  filter(!str_detect(razon, "fila\\(s\\) extraída"))
if (nrow(no_new) > 0) {
  no_new <- no_new |>
    left_join(entradas |> mutate(url = extraer_url_real(url_google)) |>
                select(url, titulo, fecha_alerta), by = "url")
  write_excel_csv(no_new, ruta_no_new_entry)
}

# Panel acumulado
if (nrow(tabla_final) > 0) {
  tf_chr <- tabla_final |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  if (file.exists(ruta_panel)) {
    panel_prev <- read_csv(ruta_panel, show_col_types = FALSE,
                           col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
    panel_new <- bind_rows(panel_prev, tf_chr)
  } else {
    panel_new <- tf_chr
  }
  write_excel_csv(panel_new, ruta_panel)
}


################################################################################
##  REPORTE  ###################################################################
################################################################################

n_con_filas <- sum(str_detect(tabla_resumen$razon, "fila\\(s\\)"), na.rm = TRUE)
n_evid    <- sum(tabla_resumen$decision == "Evidence",                na.rm = TRUE)
n_pot     <- sum(tabla_resumen$decision == "Potentially Interesting", na.rm = TRUE)
n_disc    <- sum(tabla_resumen$decision == "Discard",                 na.rm = TRUE)
n_dup     <- if (nrow(tabla_final) > 0) sum(!is.na(tabla_final$`_grupo_duplicado`)) else 0

message("\n", strrep("═", 70))
message("  RESUMEN")
message(strrep("═", 70))
message(glue("  URLs recibidas:              {nrow(entradas)}"))
message(glue("  ✓ Evidence (con filas CSDB):    {n_con_filas}"))
message(glue("  · Evidence:                  {n_evid}"))
message(glue("  · Potentially Interesting:   {n_pot}"))
message(glue("  ✗ Discard:                   {n_disc}"))
message(glue("  ──────────────────────────────"))
message(glue("  Filas generadas:             {nrow(tabla_final)}"))
if (n_dup > 0) message(glue("  Posibles duplicados:         {n_dup} filas"))
if (GEOCODIFICAR && nrow(tabla_final) > 0) {
  message(glue("  Geocodificadas:              {sum(tabla_final$lat != 'NA', na.rm=TRUE)}"))
}
if (exists("panel_new")) message(glue("  Panel acumulado total:       {nrow(panel_new)}"))
message(glue("\n  → {ruta_resultado}"))
message(glue("  → {ruta_no_new_entry}"))
message(glue("  → {ruta_panel}"))
message(strrep("═", 70), "\n")
```
